description: Rewrite lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart so ALL job reads/writes go through the already-cached campaigns and applications tables (jobs = campaigns rows with is_job=true; job applications = applications rows whose campaign_id points at an is_job campaign). Remove every .from('jobs') and .from('job_applications'). Keep EVERY existing provider name, family signature, and return type/shape so the screens need no changes: map campaigns/applications columns back to the exact keys the screens read. Depends on FEAT-001 (the columns and relaxed CHECK constraints must exist in the DB).
steps: Keep the top-level state providers unchanged: jobCategoryFilterProvider, jobSearchProvider, myJobsStatusFilterProvider.

Add a private helper that maps a raw campaigns row (is_job=true) into the job-shaped map the screens expect. Screens read: id, title, description, category, payment_amount, max_slots, deadline, cover_image_url, status. Map payment_amount from per_creator_payout, max_slots from total_slots (see null handling below), and pass through title/description/category/deadline/cover_image_url/status/id/created_at/updated_at. Keep the original column values too so nothing else breaks.

max_slots null handling: post_job_screen.dart sends max_slots as nullable; job_detail_screen reads job['max_slots'] and jobSlotCountProvider returns {'filled': int}. campaigns.total_slots is NOT NULL DEFAULT 1. Decide a single documented convention: store null max_slots as 0 in total_slots meaning 'unlimited', and when mapping back expose max_slots = (total_slots == 0 ? null : total_slots). Apply this convention consistently in createJob/updateJob (writing total_slots) and in every read mapper (reading total_slots back to max_slots).

availableJobsProvider: query campaigns .select() .eq('is_job', true) .eq('status','active'), apply category filter (eq category) and search (ilike title), order created_at desc limit 100, map each row through the job mapper. Preserve return type FutureProvider<List<Map<String,dynamic>>>.
jobCategoriesProvider: query campaigns .select('category') .eq('is_job', true) .eq('status','active'); build the distinct sorted ['All', ...cats] list exactly as before.

jobSlotCountProvider (family String jobId): count applications .select('id') .eq('campaign_id', jobId) .inFilter('status', ['applied','submitted','approved']); return {'filled': count}. Keep autoDispose + family signature.
jobDetailProvider (family String jobId): campaigns .select() .eq('id', jobId) .eq('is_job', true) .maybeSingle(); return the mapped job map (or null). Keep autoDispose + family + nullable return.
hasAppliedToJobProvider (family String jobId): applications .select('id') .eq('campaign_id', jobId) .eq('creator_id', user.id) .maybeSingle(); return response != null. Keep autoDispose + family.

myJobApplicationsProvider: applications .select() .eq('creator_id', user.id); status filter via myJobsStatusFilterProvider (skip when 'all'); order created_at desc. For each application row build a result map that has the keys the screen reads at row-level (id, status, submission_type, submission_url, submission_note, rejection_reason) PLUS a nested 'jobs' map (mapped from the campaign row) - fetch each campaign by campaign_id via campaigns .eq('id', ...) .eq('is_job', true) .maybeSingle(), mapped through the job mapper, wrapped in try/catch like the original. Also expose 'job_id' (= campaign_id) and 'applied_at' (= created_at) so nothing referencing those breaks. Return List<Map<String,dynamic>>.
adminJobsProvider: campaigns .select() .eq('is_job', true) .order('created_at', desc) .limit(200), mapped. Keep return type.
adminJobApplicantCountProvider (family String jobId): applications .select('id') .eq('campaign_id', jobId); return length. Keep autoDispose+family.

adminJobSubmissionsProvider: applications .select() .eq('status','submitted') .order('created_at', desc) .limit(200) - BUT this table also holds real campaign applications; those never have status 'submitted' (campaign apps use pending/approved/rejected/withdrawn), so filtering status='submitted' already isolates job submissions. To be safe, after fetching, for each row load its campaign via campaign_id and SKIP rows whose campaign is_job is not true. Enrich each kept row with nested 'users' (users .select('id, name, handle, avatar_url') by creator_id) and nested 'jobs' (mapped campaign row exposing id, title, payment_amount) using the same separate-fetch try/catch pattern as the original. Order by created_at desc (there is no submitted_at guaranteed non-null; use submitted_at if present else created_at - keep it simple and order by created_at desc, or by submitted_at desc if you added that column in FEAT-001 and it is populated). Return List<Map<String,dynamic>>.

JobsActionsNotifier.applyToJob(jobId): insert into applications { campaign_id: jobId, creator_id: user.id, status: 'applied', created_at: now, updated_at: now }. Keep invalidations (myJobApplicationsProvider, hasAppliedToJobProvider(jobId), availableJobsProvider) and return bool.

submitTask({applicationId, submissionType, submissionUrl, submissionNote}): update applications set status='submitted', submission_type, submission_url, submission_note, submitted_at=now, updated_at=now where id=applicationId. Keep signature, invalidation, return bool.

createJob(data): data has keys title, description, category, payment_amount, max_slots(nullable), deadline(nullable ISO), cover_image_url(nullable). Insert into campaigns: { title, description, category, per_creator_payout: payment_amount, total_slots: (max_slots ?? 0), deadline, cover_image_url, is_job: true, brand_id: user.id, status: 'active', budget: 0, escrow_amount: 0, created_at: now, updated_at: now }. Do NOT pass through the raw 'payment_amount'/'max_slots' keys as campaigns columns (they don't exist) - translate them. Keep invalidations (adminJobsProvider, availableJobsProvider, jobCategoriesProvider) and return bool.

updateJob(jobId, data): translate incoming payment_amount->per_creator_payout, max_slots->total_slots(?? 0) if present, pass through title/description/category/deadline/cover_image_url/status; set updated_at=now; update campaigns where id=jobId. Keep invalidations (adminJobsProvider, availableJobsProvider, jobDetailProvider(jobId)) and return bool.
toggleJobStatus(jobId, currentStatus): unchanged logic (active<->closed) delegating to updateJob; 'closed' is now allowed by the relaxed campaigns CHECK from FEAT-001.
deleteJob(jobId): delete from campaigns where id=jobId (cascades to its applications via FK). Keep invalidations and return bool.

approveJobSubmission(applicationId): fetch application (creator_id, campaign_id) from applications; fetch campaign (title, per_creator_payout) from campaigns by campaign_id; jobTitle from title, paymentAmount from per_creator_payout. Update applications set status='approved', reviewed_at=now, reviewed_by=admin.id. Then KEEP the existing credit_wallet rpc call (params p_user_id=creator_id, p_amount=paymentAmount) and the notifications insert EXACTLY as before (type 'job_approved', same body text). Keep invalidations and return bool.

rejectJobSubmission(applicationId, {rejectionReason}): fetch application (creator_id, campaign_id); fetch campaign title; update applications set status='rejected', rejection_reason, reviewed_at=now, reviewed_by=admin.id; KEEP the notifications insert (type 'job_rejected', same body logic). Keep invalidations and return bool.
Keep jobsActionsProvider (StateNotifierProvider<JobsActionsNotifier, AsyncValue<void>>) unchanged.
Ensure the file has NO remaining .from('jobs') or .from('job_applications'). Keep imports (flutter_riverpod, supabase_service). Preserve doc comments where helpful.
acceptance_criteria: grep for .from('jobs') and .from('job_applications') in lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart returns ZERO matches.

Every provider previously exported still exists with the same name and the same return type/family signature: jobCategoryFilterProvider, jobSearchProvider, myJobsStatusFilterProvider, availableJobsProvider, jobCategoriesProvider, jobSlotCountProvider, jobDetailProvider, hasAppliedToJobProvider, myJobApplicationsProvider, adminJobsProvider, adminJobApplicantCountProvider, adminJobSubmissionsProvider, jobsActionsProvider.
JobsActionsNotifier still exposes applyToJob, submitTask, createJob, updateJob, toggleJobStatus, deleteJob, approveJobSubmission, rejectJobSubmission with unchanged signatures.

Returned maps expose the exact keys the screens read (title, description, category, payment_amount, max_slots, deadline, cover_image_url, status; nested 'jobs' and 'users' for submission rows; row-level submission_type/submission_url/submission_note/rejection_reason/status).
credit_wallet rpc call and notifications inserts are preserved verbatim in approve/reject.
Braces and parentheses balance in the file.
verification: Brace/paren balance check on the file (e.g. an awk/python counter of { } and ( )).
grep the screens for each provider/method name and confirm the provider file still declares each one.
findings: Rewrote lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart. All .from('jobs')/.from('job_applications') removed (grep = 0 matches). Added private _mapCampaignToJob() helper mapping per_creator_payout->payment_amount, total_slots->max_slots (total_slots==0 => max_slots null), brand_id->created_by, keeping raw columns too. Reads: availableJobsProvider/jobCategoriesProvider/adminJobsProvider/jobDetailProvider all filter .eq('is_job', true); jobSlotCountProvider/hasAppliedToJobProvider/adminJobApplicantCountProvider/myJobApplicationsProvider use applications with campaign_id/creator_id. myJobApplicationsProvider fetches campaign separately (try/catch), attaches nested 'jobs' map, plus job_id and applied_at aliases. adminJobSubmissionsProvider filters status='submitted', ordered by created_at desc (submitted_at not guaranteed populated), separately fetches campaign as is_job safety-net (skips non-job rows) and attaches nested 'users' + 'jobs'. Writes: applyToJob/submitTask on applications; createJob inserts campaigns with is_job:true, status:'active', budget:0, escrow_amount:0, brand_id:user.id, total_slots:(max_slots??0), per_creator_payout:payment_amount (raw payment_amount/max_slots keys NOT written); updateJob translates only present keys; toggleJobStatus active<->closed via updateJob; deleteJob deletes campaigns row. approveJobSubmission/rejectJobSubmission fetch application (creator_id, campaign_id) + campaign (title, per_creator_payout); credit_wallet rpc (p_user_id, p_amount) and both notifications inserts (job_approved w/ rupee amount text, job_rejected w/ reason logic) preserved verbatim. VERIFICATION (no Flutter in sandbox): grep for forbidden .from() = 0; braces balanced (83/83); parens balanced 276/276 after stripping // comments (naive raw count shows 299/304 due to parens in comment prose only - all code constructs paired); all 13 provider names + 8 notifier methods declared; screen contracts confirmed against jobs_screen/job_detail_screen/submit_task_screen/post_job_screen/manage_jobs_screen/review_job_submissions_screen (keys id/title/category/description/payment_amount/max_slots/deadline/cover_image_url/status, nested 'jobs' and 'users', row-level submission_*/rejection_reason all match). Did NOT touch banners_provider/home_provider/campaigns_provider/error_utils (FEAT-003). Committed as fd61530.
